authority: NO_PROJECT_DIRECTION_AUTHORITY: GlacierEQ/job-app-helix coordinates this compiler policy; Casey Barton controls project direction and repository-native source state remains authoritative for factual implementation claims.
purpose: Compile the authenticated owned repository estate into lineage-collapsed system identities, reusable capability donors, and company/role projections without exposing private or legal source material or granting compiler classifications project-direction authority.

inputs.evidence_bound_estate_facts: optional runtime JSON passed with --estate-facts; supports namespaces[] and relationships[] with nonempty evidence_refs

namespace_policy.engineering: Eligible for lineage, capability, proof, and company projection subject to evidence gates.
namespace_policy.fork_reference: Derived from GitHub fork metadata; reference/upstream ancestry only and never counted as a native accomplishment.
namespace_policy.legal_private: Hard graph boundary. Raw repository identities and case material cannot enter company or recruiter projections.
namespace_policy.exact_legal_namespace: Requires evidence-bound explicit namespace assertions; filename heuristics are fallback discovery only and never prove a complete legal count.

lineage_policy.successor_semantics: EXPLICIT_SUCCESSOR_OF makes the asserted successor the canonical lineage root for deduplication only; it does not create project-direction authority.

projection_policy.company_problem_source: existing Helix company dossier gap_or_next_gate unless separately refreshed by current research
projection_policy.goal: Maximize distinct relevant capability proof while minimizing repository exposure and redundant evidence.

self_healing.source_digest: sha256 canonical JSON over all compiler inputs
self_healing.independent_failure: preserve unrelated systems and emit unresolved queue
self_healing.unsupported_claim: fail closed or retain metadata-only state
